Definition: Nisan, the first month of the Jewish sacred year
BiblicalUsage: Nisan is the first month, and it holds two great scenes: Nehemiah stands before Artaxerxes in the month Nisan and the king sees his sadness, and in the month Nisan the lot is cast before Haman to choose the day of the Jews' destruction.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Nisan is the month of decisions: a cupbearer's grief and a villain's lot fall in the same month, and God turns both toward deliverance.
